title: linaria viscosa subsp. spicata
intro: Linaria viscosa subsp. spicata, commonly known as sticky toadflax, is a plant species in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. The sticky toadflax plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and infections, due to its health benefits which may include antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria viscosa subsp. spicata are believed to be attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
